title: Signing key ceremony checklist (Offline bundle signing) — Release Engineering
body:
Purpose
- This checklist is used for Redwood Private offline bundle signing key ceremonies (initial generation + rotation).
- Goal: generate signing keys under controlled conditions; capture evidence sufficient for customer security reviews and internal audit; ensure reproducible trust-root distribution to air-gapped customers.

Scope
- Covers keys used to sign offline bundle manifests and/or signature envelopes used by the on-prem installer preflight verification.
- Excludes customer-managed signing roots (future roadmap).

Roles (minimum attendees)
- Ceremony lead (Release Eng): Connor O'Brien (required)
- Security approver / executive sponsor: Dr. Aisha Rahman (required for initial + emergency rotation)
- Security Engineering reviewer: Marcus Lin (required)
- GRC / evidence owner: Olga Petrov or Daniel Carter (one required)
- Key management / KMS/HSM operator: Hanae Suzuki (required)
- Build/CI observer (pipeline integration): Sahana Iyer (optional but recommended)
- SRE observer (operational readiness): Neha Kapoor or Sean Gallagher (optional)

Pre-ceremony prerequisites (T-5 days to T-1 hour)
[ ] Schedule 60–90 minutes on a recorded internal Zoom (internal recording enabled)
[ ] Confirm approvals in writing (email or Slack thread) and attach links in evidence folder
    - Initial ceremony: Dr. Aisha Rahman + Marcus Lin approval required
    - Rotation: Dr. Aisha Rahman or delegate + Marcus Lin approval required
[ ] Confirm key type + signing scheme matches ADR-0147 (do not improvise)
[ ] Confirm target environments
    - Production signing key (release train)
    - Staging signing key (optional; must be clearly labeled)
[ ] Confirm secure room / screen-sharing discipline
    - Only required attendees on the call
    - No external participants
    - No unapproved screen recordings
[ ] Confirm operator access (least privilege)
    - Signing operator role has been granted (RBAC policy bundle)
    - Access request ticket (if applicable) linked in evidence
[ ] Prepare evidence folder in Drive
    - Folder name pattern:
      shared_drives/security-and-compliance/offline-bundle-signing/evidence/YYYY-MM-DD_key-ceremony_<prod|staging>_<initial|rotation>
    - Pre-create subfolders:
      01-approvals
      02-live-screenshots
      03-logs-and-exports
      04-public-key-and-fingerprints
      05-validation-and-test-signatures
      06-post-ceremony-summary
[ ] Prepare “key ceremony notes” template (use the notes section below)
[ ] Verify time source requirements for signing validity window (air-gapped time skew considerations)
    - Confirm chosen signature validity period policy (if cert-based) and any grace guidance is documented
[ ] Prepare known-good test artifacts
    - Minimal bundle manifest sample + expected canonicalization
    - A “golden” offline bundle for verification smoke test in installer preflight
[ ] Confirm break-glass policy location (for reference only)
    - Exception process doc link available, but do NOT use during ceremony unless explicitly invoked

Live ceremony steps (do in order; capture evidence as noted)

A. Start of ceremony (5 min)
[ ] Roll call: record attendees and roles (notes + screenshot of participant list)
[ ] Confirm purpose + scope stated verbally
[ ] Confirm no one is screen recording locally (verbal attestation)
[ ] Confirm environment labels: prod vs staging (say it out loud; write it down)
Evidence to capture:
- Screenshot: Zoom participant list (include timestamp if possible)
- Notes: start time, meeting link, attendees

B. Verify the secure signing environment (10–15 min)
[ ] Identify the signing system (e.g., dedicated build runner, hardened workstation, HSM-backed service)
[ ] Confirm OS/user identity and session is clean
[ ] Confirm HSM/KMS target (name/ARN/cluster) is correct for environment
[ ] Confirm audit logging is enabled for KMS/HSM operations
[ ] Confirm network posture (no accidental outbound beyond policy; note any required endpoints)
Evidence to capture:
- Screenshot: terminal showing hostname + logged-in user + date/time
- Screenshot: HSM/KMS target identifier (redact account IDs only if required by internal policy; keep enough to uniquely identify)
- Export/log: audit log reference (link or log ID) showing ceremony session start (if available)

C. Generate signing key material (15–25 min)
[ ] Confirm key algorithm and parameters per standard
    - Must match artifact-signing standard + ADR-0147 (e.g., Ed25519 or ECDSA P-256 depending on decided scheme)
[ ] Generate key in HSM/KMS (private key non-exportable)
[ ] Create key alias/label using naming convention
    - Example: ri-private-offline-bundle-signing-prod-2025-11
[ ] Record key identifiers
    - KMS/HSM key ID
    - Alias
    - Creation timestamp
[ ] Export public key material (or public cert, if applicable)
[ ] Compute and record fingerprints
    - SHA-256 fingerprint (required)
    - Additional fingerprints if needed for tooling compatibility
Evidence to capture:
- Screenshot: key creation command output showing success + key ID (redact sensitive fields)
- File export: public key (PEM/JWK/etc) saved under 04-public-key-and-fingerprints
- Text file: fingerprints.txt with command used + output

D. Establish/verify trust distribution path (10–15 min)
[ ] Confirm where the installer trust store sources public keys
    - Embedded trust store in installer build vs external trust store file
[ ] If external trust store:
    - Update trust store file with new public key
    - Confirm format and ordering rules
    - Confirm backward compatibility (multiple keys supported)
[ ] If embedded:
    - Confirm the next installer release train includes the updated key set
[ ] Confirm key activation timing and rollout plan
    - When new key will start signing bundles
    - When old key will stop signing bundles (rotation only)
Evidence to capture:
- Screenshot: diff or file view showing trust store update (public key only)
- Link: GitHub PR (if change is in repo) or internal artifact ID
- Notes: activation date + affected releases

E. Create test signature + verify (10–15 min)
[ ] Produce a detached signature over a canonical manifest
[ ] Verify signature using verification tooling (offline)
[ ] Tamper test
    - Modify manifest bytes and ensure verification fails
[ ] (Optional but recommended) Installer preflight smoke test
    - Use latest installer build expected for pilot/GA
    - Run inspect/verify command against the test bundle
Evidence to capture:
- Screenshot: successful verification output (tool version shown)
- Screenshot: tamper case failure output (expected failure)
- Files: test manifest + signature saved under 05-validation-and-test-signatures

F. Approvals + closeout (5–10 min)
[ ] Security Engineering (Marcus Lin) verbal sign-off: key generated and evidence captured
[ ] Exec sponsor / GRC verbal sign-off (Dr. Aisha Rahman / Olga Petrov)
[ ] Confirm next actions
    - Publish public key/trust store update
    - Update docs if needed
    - Rotation comms (if applicable)
Evidence to capture:
- Notes: sign-off statements + end time
- Screenshot: final “evidence folder contents” view (show filenames, not file contents)

Post-ceremony tasks (same day)
[ ] Write a 1–2 page ceremony summary (save under 06-post-ceremony-summary)
    - What key was created (IDs, alias)
    - Who attended
    - What artifacts were produced
    - Where trust store is updated
    - When key becomes active
[ ] Upload/attach written approvals (emails/PDF exports) to 01-approvals
[ ] Ensure public key artifact is accessible to Release Eng + Security + GRC (not broader)
[ ] Open/Update tracking tickets
    - ENG-4822 (signing step) status update
    - ENG-4825 (rotation/trust store) if rotation
[ ] Update customer-facing comms plan (if rotation impacts existing air-gapped customers)
[ ] Confirm a signed bundle is produced in staging and verification passes (pipeline smoke)
[ ] Confirm evidence mapping entries updated (Confluence compliance evidence page)

Evidence capture checklist (what must exist in the folder)
Required files
[ ] approvals/approval-thread-links.txt (links to Slack/email approvals)
[ ] approvals/approvals.pdf (exported approvals if available)
[ ] live-screenshots/participants.png
[ ] live-screenshots/key-create-output.png
[ ] public-key-and-fingerprints/public-key.<pem|jwk|crt>
[ ] public-key-and-fingerprints/fingerprints.txt (include commands used)
[ ] logs-and-exports/audit-log-reference.txt (log IDs, timestamps, links)
[ ] validation-and-test-signatures/test-manifest.json (or canonical format)
[ ] validation-and-test-signatures/test-manifest.sig
[ ] validation-and-test-signatures/verify-success.png
[ ] validation-and-test-signatures/verify-tamper-fail.png
[ ] post-ceremony-summary/ceremony-summary.md

Optional (recommended)
[ ] Recording link (internal only) in approvals/recording-link.txt
[ ] Installer preflight output captured in validation-and-test-signatures/installer-preflight.txt
[ ] GitHub PR link for trust store update in post-ceremony-summary/links.txt

Where evidence is stored (authoritative)
- Primary: shared_drives/security-and-compliance/offline-bundle-signing/evidence/… (this Drive)
- Secondary reference: Confluence compliance evidence page (link in Linked Artifacts)
- Retention: follow Security & Compliance retention policy for release/security evidence (minimum 3 years unless superseded by policy)

Notes template (paste into ceremony-summary.md)
- Ceremony date:
- Environment (prod/staging):
- Type (initial/rotation/emergency rotation):
- Attendees:
- Key algorithm + parameters:
- Key alias:
- Key ID:
- Public key fingerprint (SHA-256):
- Trust store location + update method:
- Activation plan:
- Validation performed:
  - verify OK:
  - tamper fails:
  - installer preflight OK (if run):
- Known risks / follow-ups:

Reminders / common pitfalls (learned from pilots)
- Air-gapped environments often have time skew: avoid tight validity windows or ensure documented diagnostic guidance.
- Do not copy/paste public keys through tools that may normalize whitespace; always use exported files and checksums.
- Ensure the trust store update ships BEFORE (or at the same time as) the first bundles signed by the new key.
- Confirm the installer fails closed on unknown key for GA; if migration exception is needed, document it explicitly and time-box it.

Contact
- Release Eng owner: Connor O'Brien
- Security Eng reviewer: Marcus Lin
- GRC evidence owner: Olga Petrov / Daniel Carter
